## Checklist — the inclusion criteria

I confirm that:

- [ ] This PR adds, updates or removes **exactly one** tool, by editing `tools.json` only.
- [ ] The tool has a **genuinely free tier** — not a free trial, not one-off credits described as a plan, and you can finish real work with it.
- [ ] I read the tool's **own pricing page today** and the `freeNote` states what the free tier actually gives, **including its limits** (watermarks, caps, credits).
- [ ] The URL goes **directly to the official site** — no affiliate link, no referral parameters, no shortener.
- [ ] The description is one plain line: no hype, no exclamation marks, no unprovable superlatives.
- [ ] The category is one of the fixed set, and tags are short lowercase slugs.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/validate.mjs` and `node scripts/build.mjs`, and committed the regenerated `README.md` and `docs/tools.json`.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/check-links.mjs --only "<tool name>"` and the link is alive.
